claim_scope: Retrospective, label-exposed diagnostic over the frozen 526-case FreeSolv development partition. It compares the fixed AM1-BCC CHA-GB polar and PBSA(inp=2) cavity/dispersion components with the published FreeSolv calculated charging and van-der-Waals components for the same compound identifiers. The published calculation is an auxiliary force-field/sampling decomposition, not experimental truth. This audit does not fit, select, calibrate, correct, replace, or certify any endpoint; it only separates disagreement with experiment into an explicit-reference residual and a continuum-endpoint-versus-explicit-reference residual, subject to published-component rounding.

component_dominance.interpretation_boundary: Larger absolute mismatch identifies a descriptive component discrepancy against the published calculation; it does not authorize replacing or scaling that component.

decision.failure_action: Regardless of the aggregate result, do not alter any Route 1 energy, choose a profile or charge model, introduce a correction, or claim that either polar or nonpolar mismatch is causal. Use the result only to pre-register the next independently evaluated physical hypothesis.

label_exposed_error_decomposition.interpretation_boundary: The four-way gate table is a tail-exposure decomposition, not causal attribution. Both the published force-field/sampling calculation and the continuum endpoint can contribute to a Route 1 error.

polar_model_comparison_against_published.interpretation_boundary: This paired component comparison confirms or rejects agreement with one published explicit-solvent charging decomposition. It does not choose an endpoint for Route 1, establish experimental accuracy, or identify a causal missing term.

published_component_definition.caveat: Published calculated components are a GAFF/AM1-BCC explicit-solvent decomposition and are not experimental labels or a direct replacement target for Route 1.
